name: rentemester-bank-reconciliation-corrections-v33
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  bank_transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_transactions(id),
  supersedes_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(supersedes_kind IN ('direct','append-only','correction')),
  supersedes_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(supersedes_id > 0),
  supersedes_reconciliation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  superseded_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  replacement_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  bank_account_no TEXT NOT NULL,
  bank_amount_dkk REAL NOT NULL,
  replacement_journal_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(replacement_journal_hash)=64),
  plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 3 AND 160),
  principal_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(principal_kind IN ('user','service-account')),
  principal_subject_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(principal_subject_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(bank_transaction_id, replacement_journal_entry_id),
  CHECK(supersedes_reconciliation_id = supersedes_kind || ':' || supersedes_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events_current_idx ON bank_reconciliation_correction_events(bank_transaction_id, supersedes_reconciliation_id);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events_guard_insert BEFORE INSERT ON bank_reconciliation_correction_events WHEN NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id = NEW.superseded_journal_entry_id OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_transactions bt JOIN bank_accounts ba ON ba.id=bt.bank_account_id WHERE bt.id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND ba.ledger_account_no=NEW.bank_account_no AND CAST(ROUND(100 * CASE WHEN UPPER(bt.currency)='DKK' THEN bt.amount ELSE bt.amount_dkk END) AS INTEGER)=CAST(ROUND(100 * NEW.bank_amount_dkk) AS INTEGER)) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries je WHERE je.id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id AND je.status='posted' AND je.reversal_of_entry_id IS NULL AND je.source_bank_transaction_id IS NULL AND je.entry_hash=NEW.replacement_journal_hash) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries reversal WHERE reversal.reversal_of_entry_id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_journal_reconciliation_links link WHERE link.journal_entry_id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries direct WHERE direct.id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id AND direct.source_bank_transaction_id IS NOT NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events replacement WHERE replacement.replacement_journal_entry_id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_lines jl JOIN accounts a ON a.id=jl.account_id WHERE jl.journal_entry_id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id AND a.account_no=NEW.bank_account_no GROUP BY jl.journal_entry_id HAVING CAST(ROUND(100 * SUM(jl.debit_amount-jl.credit_amount)) AS INTEGER)=CAST(ROUND(100 * NEW.bank_amount_dkk) AS INTEGER)) OR (NEW.supersedes_kind='direct' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries je WHERE je.id=NEW.supersedes_id AND je.id=NEW.superseded_journal_entry_id AND je.source_bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id)) OR (NEW.supersedes_kind='append-only' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_journal_reconciliation_links link WHERE link.id=NEW.supersedes_id AND link.bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND link.journal_entry_id=NEW.superseded_journal_entry_id)) OR (NEW.supersedes_kind='correction' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events event WHERE event.id=NEW.supersedes_id AND event.bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND event.replacement_journal_entry_id=NEW.superseded_journal_entry_id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'bank reconciliation correction must supersede one same-bank current target with an exact eligible replacement'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON bank_reconciliation_correction_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'bank reconciliation correction events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON bank_reconciliation_correction_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'bank reconciliation correction events are append-only'); END;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS bank_journal_reconciliations;
CREATE VIEW bank_journal_reconciliations AS
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT je.source_bank_transaction_id AS bank_transaction_id, je.id AS journal_entry_id, je.entry_no AS journal_entry_no, 'direct' AS link_kind, 'direct:' || je.id AS reconciliation_id FROM journal_entries je WHERE je.source_bank_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND je.status='posted'
  UNION ALL SELECT link.bank_transaction_id, je.id, je.entry_no, 'append-only', 'append-only:' || link.id FROM bank_journal_reconciliation_links link JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id=link.journal_entry_id WHERE je.status='posted'
  UNION ALL SELECT event.bank_transaction_id, je.id, je.entry_no, 'correction', 'correction:' || event.id FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events event JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id=event.replacement_journal_entry_id WHERE je.status='posted'
) SELECT bank_transaction_id,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,link_kind,reconciliation_id FROM candidates candidate WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events event WHERE event.supersedes_reconciliation_id=candidate.reconciliation_id);
